name: One Day I Swear I'll Reach You
source:
Ever wanted to meet Markiplier, Jacksepticeye or MatPat from Game Theory? Well now you can! As an up and coming Let's Player, you get invited to appear as a guest at a convention, and stumble into the three internet celebrities. Try to make your best impression in both them and your subscribers! Make great friends or crash and burn in you very first live appearance in front of many of your fans.

[Edited from [url=https://setsunanoroi.itch.io/one-day-i-swear-ill-reach-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
想认识博弈论中的Markiplier、Jacksepticeye或MatPat吗？好吧，现在你可以了！作为一名崭露头角的Let's Player，你受邀作为嘉宾出席一次会议，并偶然遇到了三位网络名人。努力给他们和你的订阅者留下最好的印象！结交好朋友，或者在你第一次在众多粉丝面前现场表演时就崩溃了。

[编辑自[url=https://setsunanoroi.itch.io/one-day-i-swear-ill-reach-you]Itch.io[/url]]
